# 266_R6SEC.1 — CRITICAL: better-auth GHSA-965c-763c-88jm upgrade (RH-0)

**Base:** `main` · **Branch:** `stevevitali/r6sec-1-better-auth` · **mergePolicy:** OPERATOR (this run never merges, never deploys) · **Authority:** `GD-SEC.R6` (operator handoff 2026-11-15, verbatim in `docs/build/LEDGER.md`)

## What & why

Prod runs `better-auth@1.7.2`, exposed to **GHSA-965c-763c-88jm** (CVE-2026-114607/CVE-2026-110862, CVSS 9.1): an unauthenticated attacker who knows a user's email can sign in as that user — OAuth state is accepted as a magic-link token. Rhēma matches **all three** advisory conditions: magic-link plugin on default `storeToken` (plain), Google social provider enabled, default `"database"` OAuth state strategy (`apps/api/src/auth.ts`, `pg.Pool` adapter). Affected range `>=1.4.0-beta.18 <1.7.7`.

## The change

- `better-auth` → **`1.7.25` exact pin** (current stable; 1.8.x is beta-only) in `apps/api/package.json` + `packages/db/package.json` — the only two declarations.
- `pnpm-lock.yaml` regenerated — the entire `@better-auth/*` family lands together at `1.7.25` (`core`, all five adapters, `telemetry`) + `@better-auth/utils@0.5.1`; transitives `better-call 1.4.5`, `@better-fetch/fetch 1.3.3`.
- **Zero source/config/migration changes** — the consumed API surface is unchanged; the auth suite proves behavior.

## Upgrade notes verified against our code

- **1.7.7** (invalidates pending magic links + OAuth states) — single deploy covers; 15-min link expiry bounds it. Recorded.
- **1.7.16** (stricter wildcard `trustedOrigins`, trimmed org roles) — our origins are exact literals, no wildcards; org plugin unused. Unaffected.
- **1.7.21** (`sendVerificationEmail` throw semantics) — we don't use it; our gate is `databaseHooks.user.create.before` throwing `APIError` — refusal tests green at 1.7.25.

## Advisory census (OSV)

Full table in `docs/build/runs/266_R6SEC.1.md`. Only **RH-0** exposes us → closed by the pin. `GHSA-r4xp` is in our old version range but the `oauthProxy` plugin is disabled (not exposed). `GHSA-qq9h`/`GHSA-g38m` (both HIGH, named in the handoff) were already fixed below `1.7.2` — not exposed; `g38m`'s gate overlaps our deliberate `requireLocalEmailVerified:false` — re-audited, reasoning stands (Google-verified claims only; no attacker-controllable login path to a victim row). All other advisories are out-of-range or unused-plugin. **No new exposures → no new finding rows.** `pnpm audit --prod`: zero advisories on better-auth at 1.7.25 (99 pre-existing dev/transitive findings → **BL-114** standing gate).
